blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — China and Southeast Asian countries have made progress on a South China Sea pact but won’t be able to conclude decades of negotiations this year as agreed, three regional diplomats said on Wednesday. China and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) began negotiating the so-called “code of conduct” (COC) in 2005
